'''Debit-101''' was an audit [[Droid/Legends|droid]] specialist owned by [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]]. When his fellow audit droid [[Checksum]] reported a massive loss of profits at the [[Holiday Towers Hotel and Casino]], Debit-101 performed a careful economic analysis. His conclusion was that the hotel was losing tourist credits to [[Hologram Fun World]], which was at the time being administered by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. Zorba responded to the news by knocking Debit-101 to the floor.
